name: ghidra-delinker
notes: Prebuilt release zip for Ghidra 12.1.4. test.sh installs it into a throwaway user.home, imports a self-built x86-64 ELF, runs the bundled headless DelinkProgram.java script (exporter 'ELF relocatable object') and checks foo.o has U bar/U counter symbols and R_X86_64_PC32 relocations. Needs JDK 21, clang, lld@21, llvm@21 from Homebrew. Real Ghidra install untouched.
